practiceProblems.title: Task-4 Voting on Comments
practiceProblems.description: Practice automatic comment hiding after reports.
practiceProblems.problemStatement: Each `REPORT:id` increments the report count. A `STATUS:id` query prints `HIDDEN` when the comment has at least five reports; otherwise print `VISIBLE:<count>`.
practiceProblems.inputFormat: N followed by commands, including one STATUS query.

sampleTestCases.input: 7 ADD:1:hello REPORT:1 REPORT:1 REPORT:1 REPORT:1 REPORT:1 STATUS:1 NOOP

hiddenTestCases.input: 7 ADD:1:hello REPORT:1 REPORT:1 REPORT:1 REPORT:1 REPORT:1 STATUS:1 NOOP
hiddenTestCases.explanation: Five or more reports hide the comment; fewer reports leave it visible.
